verdict.rationale: Canny ships its own changelog product for announcing shipped features to customers, so the core of a public changelog exists. Nothing in the evidence documents custom-domain hosting or full branding of that page. missing for 10: documented custom-domain support for the changelog, documented branding/theming controls, explicit confirmation the changelog is a standalone public page, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can serve a fully branded public changelog page on a custom domain

citations.quote: Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
Product Changelog Software and Release Notes Tool
